```diff
    return displayedCount.value &lt; displayList.value.length
  })
+ 
+ // 加载更多题目
+ const loadMore = async () =&gt; {
+   if (isLoadingMore.value || !canLoadMore.value) {
+     return
+   }
+ 
+   isLoadingMore.value = true
+   
+   try {
+     // 模拟加载延迟，让用户看到加载状态
+     await new Promise(resolve =&gt; setTimeout(resolve, 300))
+     
+     // 增加显示的题目数量
+     displayedCount.value = Math.min(
+       displayedCount.value + pageSize.value,
+       displayList.value.length
+     )
+   } finally {
+     isLoadingMore.value = false
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // 滚动监听相关
+ let scrollListener: (() =&gt; void) | null = null
+ let scrollTimeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null
+ 
+ // 设置滚动监听
+ const setupScrollListener = () =&gt; {
+   // 清理旧的监听器
+   if (scrollListener &amp;&amp; scrollContainer.value) {
+     scrollContainer.value.removeEventListener(&#39;scroll&#39;, scrollListener)
+   }
+ 
+   if (!scrollContainer.value) {
+     return
+   }
+ 
+   scrollListener = () =&gt; {
+     // 防抖处理
+     if (scrollTimeout) {
+       clearTimeout(scrollTimeout)
+     }
+ 
+     scrollTimeout = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+       if (!scrollContainer.value || isLoadingMore.value || !canLoadMore.value) {
+         return
+       }
+ 
+       const container = scrollContainer.value
+       const scrollTop = container.scrollTop
+       const scrollHeight = container.scrollHeight
+       const clientHeight = container.clientHeight
+ 
+       // 当滚动到距离底部200px时，触发加载更多
+       const threshold = 200
+       if (scrollTop + clientHeight &gt;= scrollHeight - threshold) {
+         loadMore()
+       }
+     }, 100)
+   }
+ 
+   scrollContainer.value.addEventListener(&#39;scroll&#39;, scrollListener, { passive: true })
+ }
  
  // 滚动容器引用（用于滚动定位）
```
